notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - option for a bigger mouse pointer
notes.content:
Hello - made a small update with an option to make the mouse pointer bigger. This should help people with bigger screens.

To enable the bigger pointer open the settings in the game and set "Big mouse pointer" to "Yes".

Have fun!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - HQ music and standalone soundtrack released!
notes.content:
Jogward's music composer [b]Myrgharok[/b] has given the game's soundtrack a new HQ pass! So turn up that volume and and get on the grind! 

And what's best - the soundtrack is now released as a standalone soundtrack on Steam completely free! Go medieval on your enemies while listening to these aggressive and hard hitting bangers - get the soundtrack now here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1752860/Jogward_Soundtrack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1752860/Jogward_Soundtrack/[/url]

﻿

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - quality of life fixes
notes.content:
Hello, I made a small update for Jogward:
[list]
[*] Added a toggle for VSync;
[*] Fixed some fences in map that should now be easier to roll over;
[*] Made damage numbers a little smaller.
[/list]

Have fun!
